summary: Closure audit of frozen range 0bd4a998→dce9bba1 (11 changed paths) against the frozen Build D requirements, findings dispositions and correction claims, using only the supplied request.json. The increment contains exactly the two promised corrections plus evidence. (1) D5: _prompt_save_path now resolves only the prompt default before display, fixing the reproduced defect where Typer's Enter returned a relative displayed default that _resolve_save_path re-anchored under reports (duplication); the new regression test models actual Typer Enter semantics, would be RED on the old code, and includes the previously missing Path import; yes/no, <3-char, relative-anchoring and escape rules are verifiably unchanged in the frozen body. (2) D7: the three interpolated locally generated indicator details are replaced by two fixed literals added to the no_data_available allowlist, with the cause-exemption extended only to the fixed calculation literal — no vendor message, indicator argument or cause text can reach the sentinel; new tests exercise real Alpha Vantage/Yahoo entry points and assert dummy-secret absence; VendorError fallback semantics unchanged. The proof-script update (relative results in a chdir'd disposable root, prompt double returning displayed defaults) consumes exactly the four scripted answers across the save/retry flow, and the refreshed runtime receipt (relative Run log paths, new stage label, reordered attempts, 3 html pages/3 run IDs) is internally consistent with it. The seven Low dispositions are consistent with the frozen spec — the short-input rejection correctly follows the explicit frozen D5 rule, and the material D7 subset was fixed with regression evidence rather than dismissed. The acceptance D10 wording correction (verifier mirrored, not called) improves accuracy. No Critical, High or Medium in-scope gaps found; four Low observations recorded (lost supported-indicator specificity in the bounded sentinel, tests appended after the unittest main guard, receipt bound to intermediate commit 15657050 rather than audited head without per-commit verification, and cosmetic symlink resolution of the displayed default). Suite counts, receipts and byte comparisons remain builder-attested; this audit grants no integration or release authority.
limitations: Read-only audit of the single frozen request.json; I did not and could not execute pytest, ruff, the CLI replay script, or any browser proof. The corrected-candidate suite result (3309 passed / 10 skipped / 1 deselected at 15657050), the /tmp pytest log SHA-256, the /tmp CLI closure receipt, and the Ruff/diff-check claims are builder-attested; I verified arithmetic consistency (3306 + 3 new tests = 3309) and internal consistency with the diff, not execution.

The frozen diff is an aggregate base(0bd4a998)→head(dce9bba1) diff with no per-commit breakdown, so I could not independently verify that intermediate commit 15657050 carries all code changes and that subsequent commits are evidence-only, nor recompute the per-commit byte comparisons of report_html.py/reporting.py cited for browser-evidence reuse.

The refreshed runtime receipt (2026-11-07-operations-runtime.json) was checked for internal consistency with the updated proof script (prompt sequence, relative results paths, attempt structure); its actual execution, attempt directories and reopened-report hashes are builder evidence I cannot reproduce.

Module bodies were verified from the frozen requirements blob (router no_data_available, indicator.py, market.py get_stockstats_indicator, cli/run.py save-path and _offer_reports bodies, proof-script main). Modules outside that supplied set — including the full PM/research/decision-context/valuation bodies cited for the deferred contextvar disposition and the _SafeRunFormatter body — were not independently re-verified in this closure pass; dispositions relying on them rest on the frozen packet's descriptions.

Dispositions of the seven initial Low findings were evaluated for consistency with the frozen D2–D10 spec text and the supplied code; I could not re-run the builder's RED/GREEN reproductions (e.g. the D5 Enter duplication or the D7 wrapped ValueError paths).

Exact-D remote CI (Python 3.11–3.14 matrix), fresh-install smoke, and Machine 1 acceptance remain unverified for this local unpushed branch, as the packet itself declares; this audit grants no integration or release authority.

Converged within the soft limit (~15 tool turns); the full 363 KB requirements blob was read selectively at decision-relevant regions (D5/D7 specs, affected module bodies, acceptance/correction narrative) rather than line-by-line.

findings.title: Sanitized unsupported-indicator sentinel no longer names the rejected indicator or the vendor's supported list; the model/operator cannot tell from the sentinel which LLM-chosen indicator was refused (the name survives only as a suppressed lazy log arg). Bounded-literal trade-off is consistent with D7 but slightly reduces recoverability versus the prior local message

New module-level pytest tests are appended after the `if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()` guard in a unittest-style file; pytest collects them but direct `python tests/test_vendor_routing.py` execution silently skips them

Receipt binds tested_commit 15657050 while the audited head is dce9bba1; the claim that following commits add only evidence (identical application/test code at head) cannot be verified from the frozen aggregate base→head diff, which contains no per-commit attribution

`Path(default).resolve()` in _prompt_save_path also resolves symlinks, so the displayed/saved default can textually differ from the configured results_dir (e.g. macOS /var → /private/var); cosmetic only, physical destination unchanged

escalation_reasons: Frozen scope changes more than 10 files or more than 500 lines.
